title: Luxury in The Gulch w/ Patio, Pool- Walk Broadway
description:
Experience luxury in the HYVE building. Spacious condo in an unbeatable location - walk to Broadway or the Gulch for endless food & shopping. Brand new building w/ a pool, gym, common areas to work from. Enjoy your morning coffee on our huge private corner patio. Only 0.5 mi to Broadway & 0.6 mi to the Gulch! Premium hardwood floors, huge kitchen, 4 Beds and expansive windows. Relax and recharge after exploring from the city's best restaurants, bars, live music venues, shopping & so much more.

The space
★ Walk to Downtown Nashville - Broadway Bars
★ 1 King Bed, 2 Queen Beds, 1 Sleeper Sofa
★ High ceilings, large windows, and premium furnishings throughout
★ Private corner patio with outdoor furniture
★ Brand new pool with lounge chairs, cabanas, and a firepit
★ State-of-the-art fitness center with Peloton equipment
★ Common space in the building to work or lounge at
★ Highly Secure building with key code entry
★ Free Luggage storage available at the building from 10a - 4pm Thursday through Sunday
★ Free parking in the attached garage. Please note this is on a first come, first serve basis. It is not guaranteed.
★ Smart TVs in the living room + Bedroom #2
★ High-speed wifi
★ Washer/Dryer in the condo
★ Tons of natural light
★ Kitchen island with seating for 4
★ Fully equipped kitchen for all of your cooking needs
★ Keurig Coffee maker + coffee
★ Hassle-free check-in with no keys, just codes
★ Elevator in the building
★ Walking distance to the Gulch, Music City Hall of Fame, Downtown Broadway Bars
★ Hair dryers, shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided
★ Plenty of closet storage space for your clothes & other items
★ Central AC + Heat
★ Sound machine in the bedrooms
★ Full length mirrors

BEDS:
Bedroom 1: King Bed
Bedroom 2: 2 Queen Beds + Smart TV
Living Room: Queen Pull-Out Couch + Smart TV

BATHROOMS:
Bathroom 1: Full size with shower/tub combo in the hallway next to Bedroom 1
Bathroom 2:  Full size with double vanity and standing shower connected to Bedroom 2

This brand new luxury condo is impossible to beat - two spacious bedrooms, private corner patio, pool, gym, walking distance to downtown, and all the high-end furnishings/supplies you could need for the ultimate stress-free stay. Highly sought-after and extremely secure, this building is located in the heart of Nashville's rich musical history and endlessly expanding food & entertainment options. Steps from Downtown and the Gulch - just 0.5 mile walk to the Country Music Hall of Fame, Broadway's endless restaurants, and honky tonks with live artists every night. Catch a show at Bridgestone Arena, or the infamous Ryman Auditorium, both of which are a short 15 min walk! Located across the street from Jack White's record store and music venue, Third Man Records. You simply cannot beat these luxury accommodations or this location.

Our space is a memorable mix of style + comfort. All aspects of the home have been thoughtfully designed with ease + convenience in mind. High-quality mattresses + bedding, tasteful elements throughout, with modern amenities and plenty of space and natural light. This condo will allow you to rest and relax after an adventurous day exploring Nashville!

Walk To (alphabetical order):
- Ascend Amphitheater
- Bridgestone Arena (Predators)
- City Winery Nashville
- Country Music Hall of Fame
- Fifth & Broadway food hall and shopping
- Frist Art Museum
- Germantown
- Hard Rock
- Honky Tonks
- Listening Room Songwriter Cafe
- Music City Center (Convention Center)
- Shopping in the Gulch neighborhood's local boutiques like e.Allen and Rustler Hat Co.
- Restaurants such as Biscuit Love, Husk, Martin's BBQ, Oak Steakhouse, Peg Leg Porker BBQ, Superica, Two Hands, Wildhorse Saloon and numerous others!
- Ryman Auditorium
- Schermerhorn Symphony
- Titans Stadium
- Third Man Records
- Yeehaw Brewing Co.

Guest access
All other information will be given after reservation is made, including address and access instructions. There is a keypad entry, so checking in is hassle free!

Other things to note
Check in is at or after 4pm, and check out is at or before 11am. Free parking in the attached garage. Please note this is on a first come, first serve basis. It is not guaranteed. Nashville is growing quickly! There may be some construction around the area. We are located near an active train. We provide sound machines in the unit.

Early check in times selected through the app are not applicable. If you would like early check in, you must message us.
